title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ItemBatch
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ItemBatch . A uniform collection of tangible objects relevant for the production process, consisting of a set of objects with similar properties (e.g. a certain type of sensor or metal sheet). Unlike MaterialBatch, individual items can be traced within an ItemBatch (e.g. an individual metal sheet), because they carry a unique identifier (e.g. a GTIN code as a barcode/QR-code or RFID tag). Subclass of s4inma:Batch per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties (hasIdentifier, hasSize, needsEquipment, consistsOf) are documented on the Batch model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ItemBatch'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

belongsToCategory.description: Relationship. The category of items this item batch belongs to. Target model: 'ItemCategory'.

containsItem.description: Relationship. The individual items contained in this item batch (inverse of Item's belongsToItemBatch). Target model: 'Item'.
